claim: Raising the piezo controller's security level exposes settings that can damage the stage or the controller -- for example, too small an integrator time constant makes the loop unstable and damages the stage. NanoBench warns when a higher level is entered.
validity_conditions: Read from Nanobench 6000 Customer Interface Software User Manual, PS-000006-UM issue 4 / v1.0.19 (sha256 2acb47b5...): printed page 8 (PDF page 8). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. These manuals are for the controller's software; the archive holds no hardware manual for the stage or the controller. The controller was found at its lowest level on 2026-09-24 (piezo_security_level_as_found_20260924). KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
